verdicts.reason: A keeps the photo and the white card, but the logo is blown up to rival the headline and sits on the image, its 'MONOGRAPH' wordmark runs across the card edge, 'NOW OPEN' now sits below the body copy, and the card text is cramped against the top and right edges. B drops the architectural photo completely, so the design loses its look; it also flips the reading order (CTA at the top, then logo, headline, and 'NOW OPEN' last, jammed against the bottom edge) and leaves a dead white strip at the top. A is the less bad of the two.
